column1: Polynomial regular expression used on uncontrolled data
column2: A regular expression that can require polynomial time to match may be vulnerable to denial-of-service attacks.
column4: This [["regular expression"|"relative:///index.js:123:47:123:49"]] that depends on [["library input"|"relative:///index.js:62:23:62:31"]] may run slow on strings starting with ':~:text' and with many repetitions of ':~:text'.
